source: Live capture, Aside Browser, real StreamYard studio linked to an unlisted YouTube event (not live). Captured by hooking window.WebSocket at document_start via CDP Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument.
sanitization: All tokens (including URL query tokens and hello auth), room/client/broadcast/team/workspace ids, channel handles/ids, avatars and host names replaced with stable placeholders. Persian comment text retained; it is test text.

appStateSocket.role: broadcast state sync, subscriptions, starred comments, heartbeat

transport.ordering: pos is a monotonically increasing per-socket sequence number; server frames carry sentAt ISO timestamps
transport.heartbeat: both sockets exchange ping/pong (videows every ~1.5s, api every 30s)

commentEvent.duplicateDelivery: observed: the same comment id arrived twice, 5s apart (pos 12 and pos 13) - dedupe by id is mandatory

starEvent.payload: comment object plus starredAt ISO timestamp
